scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @ai-studio/agent-adapter run build && pnpm --filter @ai-studio/desktop run dev
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @ai-studio/agent-adapter run build && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @ai-studio/agent-adapter run build && pnpm -r --if-present run test
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @ai-studio/agent-adapter run build && pnpm --filter @ai-studio/desktop run test:e2e
scripts.package: pnpm --filter @ai-studio/agent-adapter run build && pnpm --filter @ai-studio/desktop run package
